methods.C0_random: Contract-only pool with seeded random order
methods.C1_static_blis: Contract-only pool ranked by the frozen BLIS-derived score
methods.C2_offline_calibrated: Design-split calibrated model without target feedback
methods.C3_online_calibrated: Design-split posterior updated after every target observation
methods.C4_misleading_online: Reflected initial posterior updated after every target observation

claim_boundary: Offline sequential replay over real x86 candidate measurements. Design workloads fit the model, validation workloads select hyperparameters, and holdout workloads are used once with fixed settings. Target-workload observations are revealed only after the policy selects that candidate. Cross-host results are not part of this package.
